author: @SlawomirNowaczyk

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking changes. The change is additive: recognized session headers arriving on inbound requests are now forwarded upstream. Existing requests without session headers behave identically. Discovery (GET /models) explicitly does not carry a session header. No schema, protocol, config, or CLI contract changes.
evidence.documentation: New section 'Session continuity headers' added to docs/guide/configuration/cloud.md (correct location per @abn's review). Documents the allowlist, the verbatim relay behavior, which headers leak vs. don't leak, and that discovery is exempt. No CLI, API spec, or behavior-change documentation needed beyond this.
evidence.manual_release_testing: CI passed (Triage dashboard: success, auto-label: success). No test logs confirm that a human exercised the session header relay end-to-end with a real cloud provider. The diagnostic logs from @ziouf confirmed the [session-diag] output appeared, but the provider returned 500 errors so success was not demonstrated. The unit tests cover the header-parsing logic in isolation but not the actual wire relay through CloudServer. This warrants a quick smoke test with a live cloud provider before release.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after the latest approval (@abn on 2026-09-10T15:10:32Z). The branch was stable through merge. The final PR head (5ba46094) contains only whitespace cleanup after the last approval.
evidence.review: PR #3510 received a comprehensive, architecture-shaping review from @abn (telemetry, HTTP specialist per contribute.md). @abn identified six concrete issues across design (hardcoded header name, subsystem coupling, discovery-side header leak, missing tests, docs in wrong file, duplicate trim function) and pushed the PR toward a much cleaner design. @superm1 (security specialist, approved per contribute.md) approved after the revisions. A tester (@ziouf) ran multiple builds and provided diagnostic logs that confirmed the relay plumbing worked correctly. The PR title, description, and labels (area::api, rfc:not-required) were all updated to match the evolved scope.
evidence.security: Well-scoped. The session relay uses a strict well-known-only allowlist (x-opencode-session, x-session-id, x-client-session-id, mcp-session-id, x-conversation-id, session-id) and deliberately excludes configured telemetry headers (telemetry.session.headers.id), preventing internal identifiers from leaking to external providers. Discovery endpoints are exempt. The thread-local g_request_session is reset per request to prevent cross-request leakage on reused worker threads. No new credential handling or network paths introduced beyond forwarding existing headers.
evidence.tests: New file test/cpp/test_session_utils.cpp with 191 lines covering well-known resolution, fallback order, configured-header precedence, whitespace trimming, case-insensitive matching, client identity namespacing, telemetry vs. relay allowlist separation, and apply_forwardable_session no-op. All checks use explicit pass/fail counters (not assert()) to survive Release builds with -DNDEBUG. Wired into CMakeLists.txt under BUILD_TESTING. Test code was cleaned of CRLF line endings (flagged by @abn, fixed before approval). No existing tests were weakened or deleted.

maintainer_todos.text: Start lemond with a cloud provider configured, send a curl request with a session header (e.g. -H 'x-opencode-session: test-abc'), and confirm the upstream provider receives the same session ID in its request headers.
Send a GET /models request and confirm no session header is attached to that discovery call.

shout_outs.reason: Substantively rewired the PR's architecture: replaced a hardcoded OpenCode-specific header relay with a generic, allowlisted session utility (session_utils.h) that forwards the actual incoming header verbatim, and mandated test coverage, documentation placement, and leak-prevention separation of telemetry vs. cloud forwarding.

subject: [cloud][fix] Relay caller session continuity headers upstream (#3510)
summary: Relays the caller's session continuity header (e.g. x-opencode-session, x-session-id) verbatim to cloud providers so prompt-cache continuity works across the Lemonade hop.
verdict_reason: The PR adds user-facing cloud-relay behavior that is thoroughly unit-tested but has no evidence of manual end-to-end exercise with a real cloud provider, so a quick integration check is warranted before shipping.
